title: Sending to a session by display name is sometimes refused 'mailbox alias inventory is unavailable' on 0fb7b034
outcome: termal_send_to_session with a valid unique local display name resolves reliably, or refuses with an accurate, actionable cause. It never refuses a resolvable unique local name because an alias inventory is transiently unavailable.
acceptance: A note on master identifies, with file and line, where 'mailbox alias inventory is unavailable' is produced, under what condition the inventory is unavailable, and whether the P0 native-addressing change (0fb7b034) introduced or exposed it. It explains why a name send at about 13:41Z succeeded while one at about 14:38Z was refused.
Fix criteria are proposed separately and concurred by the coordinator; no implementation under Greg's STOP without an exemption.
